# Introduction

The **`nogoldstandard`** analysis (Analysis Without Gold Standard) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Analysis of multiple binary tests when no perfect reference exists. Implements a conditional-independence two-class latent class model, fixed-prior penalized EM point estimation, and descriptive agreement with self-built composite reference rules. Latent classes are unlabeled, and reference-rule results are not diagnostic-accuracy estimates.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("nogoldstandard_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::nogoldstandard(
#   data = nogoldstandard_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `nogoldstandard` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
